description: This file defines the interface 'IIarm' and its nested interface 'INotification' within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It specifies method signatures for IARM bus interactions and notification handling, serving as an interface contract for plugin communication in the system.
external_files: Core::IUnknown (implied dependencies, typically from core library or framework header)

classes.name: IIarm
classes.description: An interface for the IARM bus, providing methods for connection, registration, call, broadcast, and notification registration.

classes.name: IIarm::INotification
classes.description: A notification interface for receiving events from the plugin, including a method for handling IARM events.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is connected, returning the connection status.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the IARM bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific owner and event ID.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a registered event handler for a specific owner and event ID.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call
methods.description: Makes a call to a specified method on the IARM bus with arguments.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all listeners.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_CallWithIPCTimeout
methods.description: Performs a call with an IPC timeout.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers a call handler for a method.
